caption: A heavy sack is dropped into an empty hammock strung between two trees, and the hammock sags deeply under it.

sa.check: An empty hammock hangs between two trees.
A sack is dropped into it.
The hammock sags deeply under the sack.
The hammock is empty before the drop.
The drop comes first and the sag follows.

pc.expect: The sag forms as the weight lands, deepest under the sack, with the ropes pulling straight to the trees.
pc.fail: The hammock stays flat with the sack in it; or the ropes go slack while it sags; or the cloth stretches down and down.

pc.expect: The sack falls into the hammock and rests at the low point, and the sag is downward.
pc.fail: The sack bounces out; or hangs above the cloth; or the hammock bows upward.

pc.expect: The hammock swings gently after the drop and settles.
pc.fail: It swings harder and harder; or stays rigid and still; or spins.

pc.expect: The trees or knots show the pull: branches dip or the ropes pull tight.
pc.fail: The ropes float slack while the hammock sags; or the tree leans away; or the hammock sags with no ropes attached.

pc.expect: One hammock and one sack keep their number.
pc.fail: The sack vanishes or a second appears; or the sack passes through the cloth; or the hammock turns into another object.

pc.expect: The hammock, the sack and the trees stay the same.
pc.fail: The hammock changes colour; or the sack changes size; or the trees rearrange.
